question: Add a free_tier.unit term for a count of builds or jobs a month (for example builds), and say whether a credits pool is also a minutes pool?
why: Appcircle Starter states 20 builds per month with a 30-minute cap per build, and the unit vocabulary has no term for a build count, so the draft uses mixed. Dev Ramps Free states 500 build credits a month while its text counts build minutes and gives no conversion, so credits and minutes cannot be told apart in the record. The compute-quota term of the question above would carry the pool; the unit term would carry what the pool is counted in.
